:beta: Beta — a second angle or coefficient.
:gamma: Gamma — the gamma function, curves, Euler's constant.
:delta: Delta — a small change, or the Kronecker delta.
:epsilon: Epsilon — a small positive quantity (lunate form).
:varepsilon: Varepsilon — the form most analysts prefer.
:eta: Eta — efficiency, or a learning rate.
:vartheta: Vartheta — the script form of theta.
:kappa: Kappa — curvature or a condition number.
:mu: Mu — a mean, or a measure.
:nu: Nu — a second measure, or degrees of freedom.
:xi: Xi — a random variable or auxiliary point.
:pi: Pi — the circle constant, or a projection.
:varpi: Varpi — the variant form of pi.
:varrho: Varrho — the variant form of rho.
:sigma: Sigma — standard deviation, or a σ-algebra.
:varsigma: Varsigma — final sigma, used as a variant.
:tau: Tau — time constants, torsion, Kendall's tau.
:phi: Phi — the golden ratio, Euler's totient, angles.
:varphi: Varphi — the looped form, common for maps.
:chi: Chi — characters and the chi-squared distribution.
:omega: Omega — frequency, the first infinite ordinal.
:Gamma: Capital gamma — the gamma function, or a contour.
:Delta: Capital delta — a difference, or the Laplacian.
:Lambda: Capital lambda — a diagonal matrix of eigenvalues.
:Pi: Capital pi — a product, or a projection.
:Sigma: Capital sigma — a sum, or a covariance matrix.
:Phi: Capital phi — the normal CDF, or a map.
:Omega: Capital omega — the sample space, or a domain.
:ell: Script ell — sequence spaces and lengths.
